Dlouhodobý trend celkové zátěže všech ak: The long-term trend of the total load of all activities, like Fitness & Freshness in Strava. Fitness is the average load over about 6 weeks, Fatigue over a week, Freshness the difference between them.
Trend jako Fitness &amp; Freshness ve St: A trend like Fitness & Freshness in Strava or the PMC in TrainingPeaks, from the total load of all activities. How to train today follows Readiness and Today's capacity.
Trend jako Fitness & Freshness ve Stravě: A trend like Fitness & Freshness in Strava or the PMC in TrainingPeaks, from the total load of all activities. How to train today follows Readiness and Today's capacity.
Kondice minus Únava jako podíl Kondice r: Fitness minus Fatigue as a share of Fitness on the morning of the race (see Fitness and fatigue under Body and day on Training). It is computed from the load you have done and the plan's remaining weeks. The plan's kilometres become load by how much load a kilometre gave you over the last 6 weeks.
Kapacita jednoho běhu je nejdelší běh za: The capacity of one run is the longest pain-free run of the last 30 days (older runs count less), plus a 10 % reserve. It does not come from weekly volume; it only says how long a single run the body can handle.{0} The lower of the limits always applies.
